DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：按闲置天数自动归档会话，补齐 DSH 只有手动 Archive 的缺口。支持演练模式、置顶保护、排除清单、审计日志与逐条撤销，归档走原生状态，不删任何数据。A DSH plugin that auto-archives idle sessions after a configurable number of days — dry-run mode, pinned-session protection, exclusion list, audit log and per-item undo, using DSH native archive state.
